title: Bound complete RootPlan retained backing across call histories (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with finite corroboration; no new κ. The complete unchanged PR5707 `MinimumRootPlan.compute` has an explicit numerical backing envelope across successful call histories, covering its 256 scratch tapes and 29 saved fields, including erased warm tails.

```text
b=bitlength(p), u=bitlength(C), v=bitlength(B)
c=ceil(log2 F), h=m-1, z=left+s*K+right
E=8+max(1994*b, c*h*b, z+u+v+b+g)
physical extent_i <= max(initial_i,E_1,...,E_j)
```

For fixed construction constants, the production law gives a cold bound of `O(left+right+p^(499497/500000)+bitlength(p)+u+v)`. Numeric side widths are necessary: the direct p=2, s=right=0, C=B=1 family stores `gaussians=2^left`, requiring left+3 cells through RIGHT.

The new step transfers the standalone callee envelope to every other caller expression and physical tape history. It charges uncropped capped-product intermediates and large encoded row/address fields. Produced by Nick Petalas. Credit JoyboyBrian's PR6098 standalone theorem, Ali Romman's PR5707 planner and PR5688 prefix theorem, Jose Manuel's PR3385 physical Count/RootPlan cohort, and the retained source lineage. The standalone theorem is a cited mathematical premise, not a result re-audited here.

## Evidence

- Before: PR6098 explicitly leaves the enclosing 256-tape caller history open. Its standalone bound does not account for the caller's other live values or saved powers.
- After: `PROOF.md` accounts for the complete expression ledger and proves a per-physical-tape history maximum. Seven complete source executions check all 1,961,741 owned writes, every borrowed input, all 29 canonical fields, pool closure and owned cleanup. One uses production parameters at p=2; six use the retained explicit reduced tuple to exercise both branches and warm/cold reuse. These are corroboration, not an exhaustive all-input computation.
- 256 parameter substitutions, seven address lower-bound fixtures, digit-only side-width rejection and erased-warm-backing controls pass. Both registered warning-strict normal/optimized commands pass locally in 1.751 and 1.763 seconds. Metadata, source compilation, staged whitespace, committed bytes and source-history preflight pass. The official 11-file export and its integrity check pass, as does an isolated optimized Git-free exported replay with empty PATH. The verifier generates a receipt bound to all six package files.

Exact reproduction from the worktree root, using the local CPython 3.12 interpreter and standard library:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/rootplan-backing-envelope/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -W error -B research/rootplan-backing-envelope/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rootplan-backing-envelope
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/rootplan-backing-envelope --check-source-history
```

Scientific source base is canonical main `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`, refreshed before publication. Five live source files, including the complete authenticated transitive archive, are pinned in SOURCES.json. The cited standalone mathematical source is PR6098 at `f8c31f448c633883b21c92a7b4bf3c4cf0d3c729`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

Successful-call storage only; constants are sufficient and conservative. No general pool-sufficiency theorem, exceptional-exit proof, Python heap bound, surrounding RootLayer payload/storage bill, movement/time bound, numerical accuracy theorem or complete selected framework assumption is established. Production-law fast cases are covered by the written argument; finite fast fixtures use the explicitly reduced parameter law. No full selected replay, predecessor scientific suite, proof-kernel run or independent human review is claimed.

## Open next questions

- Bind one actual root descriptor producer's restrictions on left, right, C and B, then add the nonplanner retained tapes to obtain an enclosing root storage bill.
- Sharpen the 1994*b parameter term or supply a physically charged capped multiplication implementation that avoids full temporary products.

## Related open work

Live open-work search refreshed. No additional PR on this RootPlan backing object was found.

- [PR #6098](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6098) proves the standalone minimum-prefix callee envelope; this contribution cites it and answers its first open question by covering the complete 256-tape caller and 29 fields. Its standalone quantities are not recomputed as this contribution.

## CI notes

**Uncertified by CI.** For head `3f94b96e03ea482bb3d5127463001706d44faa3e`, [run 40725045913](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40725045913) failed `plan` in the shared onboarding helper tests. `replay (research/rootplan-backing-envelope)` was skipped, so **the package replay did not run in CI**. The local passing replays above remain separate evidence.

The failed tests are:

- `test_research_current_status.CurrentStatusTests.test_current_section_matches_selected_record`: expects the exact text `**0.003125804**` in `docs/research/current-status.md`; main instead puts the decimal and fraction together inside one bold span, `**0.003125804 = 781451/250000000**`.
- `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: expects `` `make frontier6030-verify` `` in `docs/ci-verification.md`; that document still presents the PR5599 replay.

These mismatches are already present on base/main [721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419), the PR6030 κ admission pushed with `[skip ci]`. That commit changed the selected record without bringing the two documentation contracts into agreement. This package changes neither document. I confirmed the same two failures in [PR #6120's run 40691776027](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40691776027). Open [PR #6050](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6050) targets the documentation fix.

A maintainer re-run is required after main is fixed. No CI certification or completed hosted package replay is claimed.

## Merge Danger

Two-way door. Blast radius: this isolated research package and its opt-in replay only.
